claims: The reverse direction switch changes the rotation of the fan blades to push air upward or downward.
Running the fan in reverse at low speed during winter helps circulate warm air trapped near the ceiling down into the room.
In summer, setting the fan to spin forward creates a cooling breeze by pushing air straight down.

claims.text: Ceiling fans have a reverse direction switch to help in both heating and cooling a room.
